Initial release: EasyEDA Pro API integration skill for AI agents.

- Provides full API reference (120+ classes, 62 enums, 70 interfaces, 19 type aliases) for EasyEDA Pro (嘉立创EDA专业版).
- Includes a Node.js WebSocket bridge server to execute code in EasyEDA Pro's runtime from AI agents.
- Supports command triggers and auto-discovery of running bridge server/EDA windows.
- Usage guides for session setup, connection, window selection, and code execution.
- Enforced product naming consistency: always use "EasyEDA" (English) or "嘉立创EDA" (Chinese).
- Complete documentation and quick reference for all API classes, methods, enums, and interfaces.
